collateral-defects-found-during-repair: The W6 permanence rehearsal matrix recorded a pre-squash W6 branch tip as its rehearsal-head, which becomes unfetchable once that branch is deleted. It was re-stamped twice in this release: first to the published commit fc1a6fa36, and then, after the v1.00.31 bake's BUG-0009 sweep invalidated two of its nine digest-bound rehearsal inputs, the matrix was regenerated by its canonical generator and re-stamped again to the last published commit 50bdf7334a9161e9e930b40be0870c52a498a0b9. The committed matrix now records that head and inputs digest fb224a6f, not the original pair. Both identities are superseded; the current values are the ones in artifacts/wave-delivery-integrity/v1.00.31-w6/injection-matrix.json and are restated in the release report.
Editing that matrix generator invalidated its own recorded input digest; caught by the provenance guard it feeds.

A multi-line workflow run block whose first line is a shell assignment is classified not-a-script by the W1 invocation contract and then refused because the block names main.rkt (a regression introduced during the repair itself).

The fast-shard launcher failed closed on the off lane because --telemetry-file pointed into a directory only created by the skipped resolution step; the consuming step now creates it, mutation-proven.
A mutation test asserted against the skipped step's identical mkdir and was therefore vacuous; it now anchors inside the shard step's own run block.

local-chain-correction.correction: Re-measured on 2026-09-25 against the W4 implementation head 1158f1b7023b08c9608f59c8cd4c0c04915d5de6 in a worktree with no q/ sibling, so the resolver lands on the intended tree: focused 185 tests, arch 32/32, security 64/64, workflows 33/33, fast 1208/1208 (17987 tests), check-deps, metrics lint and the provenance lint all exit 0, and sha256sum -c verifies all six bound W4 artifact files. The wave's content is green when measured properly; the retained capture is superseded for its runner-suite sections by this re-measurement.
local-chain-correction.root-cause-fix: Fixed in the v1.00.31 W7 bake: the launch tree now wins over any q/-shaped sibling, with four regression tests in tests/test-runner-base-dir-resolution.rkt. The defect was invisible until a suite finally ran against the tree it was launched in — the W7 bake's own first chain run surfaced 12 failing files that every previous misdirected run had hidden.
local-chain-correction.what-happened: The verify-chain capture retained with the W4 repair was produced by the test runner with scripts/run-tests/classify-metadata.rkt resolve-base-dir preferring the neighbouring q/ clone over the worktree the runner was launched in (the candidate list tried <orig>/q and <parent-of-orig>/q before the launch tree). All four runner-suite sections of that capture (arch, security, workflows, fast) therefore describe a different checkout, not the repaired W4 tree. The suite happened to pass there, so the capture was not wrong in its verdict — it was not a measurement of the wave it was filed under.
local-chain-correction.what-is-unaffected: The wave's authoritative delivery evidence: implementation PR #9752's 22/22 required checks ran on the branch in CI, which checks the branch out itself; main run 36087264560 concluded success; the merge-SHA binding, the governance gate and status delivered are unaffected. The W4 focused raco test, check-deps, metrics lint and the provenance lint in the original capture did run against the W4 worktree — their outputs carry its absolute paths — so only the four runner-suite sections needed re-measurement.

why-it-was-blocked.note: Counts and wording are taken verbatim from the block report; the launch itself was additionally on HOLD because the predecessor main run 34749378379 failed gsd-governance ('evidence is not a hash' in the W11 binding) and live protection omitted the policy-required lint-quality check. No delivery, merge, binding publication or journal advance was performed while blocked: delivery-w4.rktd stayed delivery-pending.
why-it-was-blocked.primary: The action declared a producer invocation of scripts/ci/compiled-root.rkt that could not execute as written: the CLI required --checkout/--module/--final-dir while the action passed a whole-checkout form, so no trusted root was ever published. The text-only contract test matched the declared string and the rollback drill drove the CLI with the correct flags, so both '109/109 focused' and '1202/1202 fast' went green on a broken call.
